svg.text: CN10 USB-C: PRIMARY DEV PORT -- SWD + RTT debug, VCP console, 5V_STLK power in
flash + attach: mise run flash nucleo-n657x0 [--project net]
boot; JP1 + CN9 stay at defaults.
CNN stage reuses the mic + Ethernet paths: no extra wiring
morpho CN15 is the routing of record for the amp:
pin 3 PH9 SCL, pin 5 PC1 SDA, pin 31 PE9, pin 33 PD0;
pin 38 PA1 = G2 fallback ADC tap
acoustic path: exciter drives the clamped H2C toolhead; the mic captures its response (closed loop)
* ARS-assigned signal (provisional, gates G0-G5) -- pinout.md is the authority
MSO digital channels: C = SCL + SDA (2), E = PE9 carrier edges, F = PD0 mute, G = NRST, H = PC13 (morpho CN3 pin 23) -- six of eight; analog (circles) is 2 per run
Arduino V3 header data: UM3417 Rev 3, Table 12. A0-A5 route through the on-board 3.3V-to-1.8V adaptation amplifier; the 1.8V-domain ADC pin is shown. Morpho rows: odd/even names, Table 13.
